tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Right derivatives bound forward difference quotients]

↗ def:forward-difference-quotient

If $f$ has right derivative $c$ at $t$, then its forward difference quotient there is at most $c$.
Proof

\sketch

The relevant difference quotients converge to $c$.

□

Lemma
[Forward difference quotient comparison lemma]
